reviews.question: Paraphrase ba lần cho mỗi câu, dùng đa dạng cấu trúc và từ vựng nhưng giữ nguyên hoàn toàn ý nghĩa gốc.
reviews.originalEssay:
1.Many people believe that money is one of the most important factors in achieving happiness.
+> Many people think that money is a very important factor in achieving happiness.
+> It is widely believed that having money plays an important role in making people happy.
+> A large number of people consider money to be one of the key things that can bring happiness.
2. Some people say that the best way to improve public health is by increasing the number of sports facilities. Others, however, believe this would have little effect.
+> Some people believe that public health can be improved by providing more sports facilities. However, others think this would not have much effect.
+> It is argued that adding more places for people to do sports is the best way to improve public health. In contrast, some people believe that this would make little difference.
+> Some people think that increasing the number of sports centres is the most effective way to improve people's health. Others, however, argue that this measure would have very little impact.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ ba cách cho mỗi câu và có thay đổi cấu trúc. Tuy nhiên, hai cách của câu A đã làm mất ý tiền là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất, còn cách đầu của câu B làm mất ý đây là cách tốt nhất. Em sửa lại ba câu này để giữ đủ ý gốc, rồi nộp lại cả sáu câu.

reviews.question: Viết thành chuỗi hoàn chỉnh: professional sporting events (World Cup/Olympics) → facilitate tourism and related commercial activities → employment opportunities for local people.
reviews.originalEssay: Professional sport events, such as the World Cup or the Olympics, can facilitate tourism and related commercial activities. These events attract many visitors from different places. As a result, tourists spend money on hotels, restaurants and transportation. This helps local businesses develop and creates more employment opportunities for local people. Therefore, professional sport events can bring benefits to the local community.
reviews.overall: Em đã giữ đủ ba mắt xích: sự kiện thể thao, du lịch và hoạt động thương mại, rồi đến việc làm cho người địa phương. Cách nối từ hoạt động du lịch sang cơ hội việc làm rõ và đúng chiều. Tuy nhiên, cụm diễn đạt trọng tâm còn bám sát đề bài nên chưa thể hiện paraphrase. Em viết lại câu bằng từ khác, đồng thời dùng một cách nối kết quả gọn hơn.

reviews.originalEssay: Reading fictional or real-life stories allows children to have better imagination. When children read stories, they can conjure up different images in their minds, such as a wonderful world, a homeless person's suffering or a joyful moment. By imagining these different situations, children can develop their ability to think creatively. As a result, reading can boost children's creativity and help them become more imaginative.
reviews.overall: Bài em đã có đủ các bước chính và dùng được các hình ảnh được giao. Tuy nhiên, em cần viết rõ rằng trẻ tự hình dung các cảnh đó, vì đây là mắt xích bắt buộc của chuỗi. Câu cuối lại làm cho reading trực tiếp tăng sáng tạo, trong khi ý trước phải là việc trẻ tự hình dung dẫn đến kết quả này. Em sửa lại mối nối đó rồi nộp lại chuỗi hoàn chỉnh.

reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
It is true that advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life. This is a trend that has both positive and negative effects on consumers and society.
Admittedly, advertisements can bring some benefits to consumers and society. First, they help people know more about different products and services. For example, advertisements on social networking platforms, websites and billboards show people many products on the market. Therefore, consumers can have more choices when they want to buy something. Second, advertising can help the economy develop. When people see advertisements, they may buy more products. As a result, companies can sell more goods and create more jobs for workers. Therefore, advertising can bring some benefits to society.
However, I believe that advertisements have more negative effects. First, they can make people buy things that they do not really need. For example, advertisements often use famous people or influencers to promote products. People may buy these products because they like or follow these people. This can lead to unnecessary and wasteful spending. Second, people are exposed to advertisements very often in their daily lives. They can see advertisements on social media, websites, television and in public places. As a result, they may always want to buy new and expensive things. This can make people spend too much money and feel unhappy with what they already have.
In conclusion, advertisements are becoming increasingly common and this trend has both positive and negative effects. Although advertisements can provide useful information and support economic growth, they can also encourage unnecessary spending and make people want more material things.
reviews.overall: Em đủ số từ, bố cục rõ và đã dùng đúng hai lợi ích cùng hai tác hại của quảng cáo. Tuy nhiên, câu đầu mở bài chép nguyên văn đề nên chưa phải paraphrase. Em cũng cần phát triển đủ chuỗi kinh tế đến sản xuất, việc làm và nguồn thu ngân sách; chuỗi xã hội thực dụng đến hệ quả các giá trị tinh thần bị xem nhẹ. Câu mở Body 2 không nên tự đổi bài từ lập trường hai mặt Cô giao thành khẳng định mặt hại nhiều hơn; hãy giữ nhất quán quan điểm cân bằng ở mở bài và kết bài.

reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, many people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals in various ways. This essay will, accordingly, discuss how advertising negatively affects people and explore some effective solutions that can be implemented to minimize these harmful effects. 
On the one hand, advertising can affect people in two main negative ways. Firstly, commercials often show exaggerated images and false promises about products, which makes consumers believe the items are much better than they really are. When people buy these items and realize the truth, they often feel disappointed and lose their money. Secondly, heavy advertising leads to serious information overload. People see advertisements everywhere every day, from television and billboards to websites and social media platforms. This constant exposure creates artificial needs and pressures people into buying things they do not really need, which causes them to waste a lot of money. 
On the other hand, several solutions can be implemented by governments to minimize these negative impacts. To begin with, governments should adopt several measures such as imposing strict censorship on all advertisements. Rigorous content checks must be carried out before the release of any commercial to ensure that product descriptions accurately reflect their true quality. In addition, there should be a clear restriction on the number of platforms on which a company is permitted to market its products. This strategy will effectively protect consumers against information overload and help them avoid making unnecessary purchases. 
In conclusion, powerful advertising clearly brings negative impacts to individuals, including false expectations and unnecessary spending. However, governments can solve these problems by introducing strict censorship and limiting the platforms used for marketing.
reviews.overall: Em đã trả lời cả hai câu hỏi, mở mỗi đoạn thân bài bằng ý chung và dùng các giải pháp tương ứng với hai tác hại. Tuy nhiên, mở bài còn giữ gần nguyên các cụm chính của đề nên chưa thể hiện rõ cách diễn đạt lại đã học. Ở ý quá tải thông tin, em mới kể nơi xuất hiện quảng cáo rồi chuyển sang mua sắm; cần giải thích tác hại trực tiếp của việc bị quảng cáo dồn dập. Em cũng cần nói rõ hơn cách mỗi biện pháp ngăn đúng tác hại đã nêu.

On the one hand, advertising can affect people in two main negative ways. Firstly, commercials often show exaggerated images and false promises about products, which makes consumers believe the items are much better than they really are. When people buy these items and realize the truth, they often feel disappointed and find that they have wasted money on products that do not meet their expectations. Secondly, heavy advertising leads to serious information overload. People see advertisements everywhere every day, from television and billboards to websites and social media platforms. Repeated pop-ups can interrupt online activities, leaving users frustrated. Constant promotion of nonessential products can also make those goods seem desirable, pressuring some consumers to buy things they do not really need and waste money.

On the other hand, several solutions can be implemented by governments to minimize these negative impacts. To begin with, governments should adopt several measures such as imposing strict censorship on all advertisements. Rigorous content checks must be carried out before the release of any commercial to ensure that product descriptions accurately reflect their true quality. Such checks could help consumers avoid buying products that fail to meet their expectations. In addition, there should be a clear restriction on the number of platforms on which a company is permitted to market its products. By limiting the channels through which a company can repeatedly reach consumers, this measure could ease information overload and reduce pressure to make unnecessary purchases.

In conclusion, powerful advertising clearly brings negative impacts to individuals, including false expectations, information overload and unnecessary spending. However, governments can reduce these problems by introducing strict content checks and limiting the platforms used for marketing.
